The final function `record_13` is truncated mid-expression and will not parse.

The structure is a textbook case of copy-paste repetition. Every function differs from its neighbors only in two constants: the record number and the multiplier. That is exactly the shape the DRY principle exists to prevent. Below I walk through the specific issues, then give a revised implementation and a short discussion of trade-offs.
